name: Leaf Vein Network Skeleton Analysis
description:
Perform a morphological skeleton analysis on a leaf vein network using Fiji.

1. Open the 'Leaf' sample image (File > Open Samples > Leaf).
2. Convert the image to 8-bit grayscale.
3. Create a binary image isolating the vein network. Note: The veins are dark on a light background. You may need to invert the image (Edit > Invert) after thresholding so the veins are WHITE pixels on a BLACK background, which is required for skeletonization.
4. Skeletonize the binary vein network (Process > Binary > Skeletonize).
5. Run the 'Analyze Skeleton (2D/3D)' plugin (Plugins > Skeleton > Analyze Skeleton).
6. Save the resulting branch analysis table to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/skeleton_analysis.csv.

The output CSV must contain columns for '# Branches', '# Junctions', and 'Average Branch Length'.

metadata.image_source: Fiji built-in sample (File > Open Samples > Leaf)
